# Flossie Tulk

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Flossie Tulk is an unpleasant and caustic-tongued young woman who is personified by her malice, though she is also bold enough to ask questions on behalf of her classmates. She attends college simply to gain an education rather than to earn a livelihood, and she once wished to play the fairy queen in a school dialogue. Academically, she lacks a creative mind and is hindered by arithmetic, though she possesses skills in knitting lace and stepping along wooden fences.

## History

Flossie Tulk once won the top prize for knitted lace at the [Exhibition](../codex/places.md#exhibition). At a party hosted by [Isolde Pembroke](../character/isolde-pembroke.md), Flossie dared [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) to walk across the kitchen roof's ridgepole, leading to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) slipping and breaking her ankle. Later, Flossie attended Regent's [Academy](../codex/places.md#regent-s-academy) as a student alongside classmates such as [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) and [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md).
